limitations: Published region centers are study points. Landing safety and trajectory reachability are outside the model.
Solar qualification uses positive apparent Sun-center clearance and Earth occultation of the Sun center. Time below threshold can include partial-disk illumination.
Earth-center geometric line of sight cannot establish a communications link or station availability.
Two-metre observer height, radial up, astronomical bodies evaluated in airless reception geometry.

The model assigns each LOLA cell a constant radial height. In the narrow transition annulus, both scales contribute and the higher apparent terrain wins. Nominal 5 m pixels are largely interpolated. Surface roughness below the DEM scale and DEM reconstruction error are outside the numerical bounds.
Horizon enclosures use spherical caps around each projected cell rather than sampling at a few rays.
The far-field cap assumes no unmodeled point exceeds 1,750 km lunar radius. Sector uncertainty is retained when the cap or the numerical terrain envelope spans the target elevation.

The 0.03°/min angular-motion envelope is an adopted ceiling for the explicitly audited coverage and observers; dense sampled checks do not prove a continuous physical bound. Time-grid and terrain sensitivity limits measure numerical and model variation.
Half-open UTC mission windows. Candidate starts are evaluated on a user-selected UTC grid.

Future UTC epochs use the frozen naif0012.tls leap-second table. Future leap-second decisions require an updated kernel and revalidation; displayed numerical brackets are not physical clock-accuracy guarantees.
manifest.transformations: Native LOLA cells to lunar Cartesian elevation bounds. Refine terrain ranges, angular bins and apparent directions, retain both interval enclosures, export compressed runs.

extendedCoverage.method: Original coarse/fine terrain models; UTC monthly temporal grids; checked contiguous splicing.

formulae: omega <= sum |Euler angle derivatives|; observer v <= Moon barycentric v + omega*r.
Observer a <= Moon barycentric a + r*(sum |Euler angle second derivatives| + 2*omega^2).
For target speed B, acceleration A and retarded guard T: D = geometric relative speed + A*T + omega*r + target velocity-seam jump; |q'| <= D*c/(c-B) away from seams.

Retarded range >= geometric center range - observer radius - B*T - target position-seam jump. The upper range bounds every light-time iterate; smooth-piece contraction and seam allowances control the converged Newtonian result.
For b >= |observer v|/c, a >= |observer acceleration|/c, w >= uncorrected angular rate: stellar rate <= (1+2*b+b^2/sqrt(1-b^2))*w + (2+2*b/sqrt(1-b^2))*a.
Add the frame angular speed and scale by the pinned LSK UTC/TDB derivative bound.
Record boundary jumps and two pointwise implementation angular allowances must fit the existing angular padding.
The Earth disc-radius sensitivity is R_earth/[range*sqrt(range^2-R_earth^2)]; multiply by the range-rate or range-jump enclosure.
Sun-center jump + Earth-center jump + Earth disc-radius jump must fit 2*ANGULAR_PADDING_DEG; radius-rate must remain below 0.000006 deg/s.

implementation_allowances.qualification: Declared conservative numerical allowances exercised by reconstruction tests, not a formal verification of every CSPICE instruction.

limitations: No observational or physical accuracy is established; kernel fitting, lunar frame alignment and DEM uncertainty remain separate.
No terrain calculation is changed or validated by this motion enclosure.
General-relativistic deflection and gravitational light-time delay are outside the existing Newtonian CN+S model.
The pinned leap-second table defines future UTC conversion; future official leap-second decisions can change that convention.
The interval arithmetic is tested software, not machine-checked formal verification; implementation allowances are explicit assumptions.

rounding.method: Binary64 coefficients converted exactly, Decimal FLOOR/CEILING interval Clenshaw and differentiated coefficients; sqrt enclosed by neighboring Decimals; float endpoints rounded outward.

motionEnvelope.scope: Conservative pinned-kernel piecewise-polynomial Newtonian CN+S enclosure, conditional on the explicit implementation allowances.

visibilityDefinitions.earth: Apparent Earth center clears the terrain skyline. Surface-terrain line of sight only.
visibilityDefinitions.joint: Both Sun-center qualification and Earth-center line of sight.
visibilityDefinitions.sun: Apparent Sun center clears the terrain skyline and is outside the apparent Earth disc. Center qualification excludes solar-disc fraction, full shadow and solar-array power.
visibilityDefinitions.uncertain: Numerical or terrain bounds overlap the qualification threshold.
visibilityDefinitions.unknown: Unresolved terrain coverage or timestamps beyond the offline bundle.
